A '''milk bottle''' is a stackable portion of milk. Drinking one removes all status effects, like a milk bucket, and gives the glass bottle back.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/milk_bottle.json}}</ref> It replaces {{MCW|Beetroot Soup|beetroot soup}}.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A milk bucket and 4 glass bottles make 4 milk bottles. Obtaining a milk bucket unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Drinking a milk bottle takes 0.8 seconds and clears every effect, good or bad (the tooltip calls this "Cleanse"). Like the pack's other foods it restores no hunger, and it doesn't heal. Milk bottles stack to 64, so they are a portable cure for the [[Wither effect|Wither]] effect and other maleffects; the developer asks players to bring milk or [[bread]] to [[Hell]].<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=Please bring milk or bread to Hell, please its very important}}</ref>

Milk bottles are used in [[cheese]], [[cake]], [[Ice Cream|ice cream]], [[Glow Berry Crumble|glow berry crumble]], [[latke]]s, [[Chorus Mochi|chorus mochi]], [[Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|apple cinnamon oatmeal]], [[stroganoff]] and the green curry, paneer and pumpkin curry [[stock]]s.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.5-alpha|The milk bottle recipe unlocks when obtaining milk.}}
{{History line|1.10|Milk got a new cleanse tooltip icon, so older milk bottles don't stack with new ones.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|The milk bottle no longer carries 2 nutrition and 1.2 saturation, so drinking it restores no hunger.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/matcha/milk_bottle.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|2=Drinking a milk bottle takes 0.8 seconds, down from 1.6.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/milk_bottle.json}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.6-alpha|quote=Milk Bottles are now fast to drink}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.8-beta|date=October 23, 2026|2=Milk bottles from older versions update to the 0.8-second drinking time; until then the item updater still gave them 1.6 seconds. The updater's check now looks for a version tag that no milk bottle carries, so every held milk bottle is rewritten, to the same components, whenever the inventory changes (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/item_modifier/modify/milk_bottle.json}}</ref>}}
}}
